source: PRD FR-40 (line 224) and section 8 step 3 (line 135): a model value counts only if its text is found on the page (fuzzy match to OCR words), else REVIEW_REQUIRED; Architecture Essentials rule 10 repeats it for vision-model values. Rule reference RULE-OCR-01 (md/rules.json) — its 'value not found on page' leg.
note: Thresholds are labelled placeholders: the PRD requires fuzzy matching but gives no numbers, and section 19 does not list them as an open question — so they are set here, marked, and must be calibrated by a human against real scans before anyone relies on them. REVIEW_REQUIRED means a human reads the page; it never blocks, rejects, or changes a stored value.
human_review: An ungrounded model value is kept as a candidate with grounding REVIEW_REQUIRED and a warning on the 201; an officer decides what it means. Grounding is field provenance: verification never rewrites it and no rule reads it to pass or fail anything.
